Let me know if you would like to do this, and I can delete the account linked to your old email address so that you can then register a new one, linked to an email address of your choice.

If you have credits on your account, just let me know and I’ll help transferring them to your new account.

Macro: account_edit_phonenumber. Title: Account::Edit::PhoneNumber. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out.

It’s not possible to edit your mobile number in the app after you’ve registered.

What I can do, however, is delete your current number so that you can add the new one. Once I’ve deleted the current number, you’ll receive a message with information about how to register the new number. You’ll then be able to use the account as per usual.

Let me know if you want me to delete the current number for you.

Macro: account_edit_newphonenumber. Title: Account::Edit::NewPhoneNumber. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for your patience.

Your mobile number has now been deleted. If you want to continue to use the same account, follow the steps below to register your new mobile number:

• Log out from your Voi account and try to log in again.
• Enter your new mobile number.
• Follow the instructions that were sent to you by text message.
• Enter your email address (the one associated with your account).
• Verify your email address.

Your mobile number will be updated and you’ll be able to use the Voi app again.

Reach out again if you have more questions.

Macro: account_delete_accidentnodeletion. Title: Account::Delete::AccidentNoDeletion. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out to us.

I've checked your account and can see it's linked to a reported incident involving one of our vehicles. Because of this, we need to keep certain account information for potential legal and/or insurance processes.

This means we're not able to delete your account right now.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out — we're happy to help.

Kind regards,.

Macro: account_delete_general. Title: Account::Delete::General. Body: Hi Vojtech,

I'm sorry to hear that you want to delete your Voi account. Is there anything I can do to turn your experience around?

You can delete your account directly in the Voi app. Go to your profile and click on Account at the top. The button “Delete Account” will be at the bottom.

Keep in mind that you won’t be able to delete your account if you have an active Voi pass or an outstanding payment in connection to your account. If that's the case, you’ll need to first cancel the pass and/or pay the outstanding payment before proceeding with the deletion.

If you would like all of your data to be deleted along with your account, please put in a request through our privacy website before you delete your Voi account - https://privacy.voi.com/.

If you face any issues with deleting your account, don’t hesitate to reply to this email. I'm here to help!

Best,.

Macro: account_delete_confirmation. Title: Account::Delete::Confirmation. Body: Hi Vojtech,

I can confirm that your Voi account has been deleted.

Have a nice day!

Best,.

Macro: account_delete_90days. Title: Account::Delete::90Days. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out.

I can confirm that the deletion process takes effect immediately upon request. However, it takes 90 days for the data associated with the account to be deleted from our systems. This is in accordance with our privacy policy agreement (section 5), which outlines how long personal data is stored for and the circumstances under which it may be processed or deleted.

If you’d like more information on this or have any further questions, Feel free to refer to our privacy policy agreement (https://www.voi.com/legal/voi-privacy-policy).

Macro: account_login_blocked_multipleaccounts. Title: Account::Login::Blocked::MultipleAccounts. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for your patience.

It looks like multiple accounts were registered from the same device, which led to your new account being suspended. To continue using our service, please log in with your original account.

We're unable to help further until you've regained access to your previous account. Let us know if you have any trouble logging in.

If your previous accounts have been deleted or you no longer have access to them, you won't be able to use our services until the restrictions are lifted. We're unable to share a specific timeframe for this.

Thanks for your understanding.

• The email address or phone number associated with the previous account(s)
• Any issues you experienced with the previous account(s)

Once we have the above information, we’ll do our best to assist you further.

Macro: account_login_logintips. Title: Account::Login::LoginTips. Body: Hi Vojtech,

To access your account, complete the following steps:
Open the app and log in with your mobile number (make sure to select the right country code).Enter the verification code that was sent to you by text message.


If there’s a Voi account associated with your phone number, you’ll be logged in successfully.

If there’s no account associated with your phone number, you’ll be asked to enter your email address. You’ll then need to confirm your registration by clicking the verification link in the email that was sent to you. If the link doesn’t work, use the code in that same email and enter it in the app.

Please reach out again if still have problems logging in.

Macro: account_login_loginissues. Title: Account::Login::LoginIssues. Body: Hello Vojtech,

Thank you for contacting us and I’m sorry you're having issues accessing your account.

To understand better what the problem could be, could you please confirm what email address or phone number you're trying to use to access your account?

If the email address from your Voi account is different from the one you're using to contact us, please contact us instead through the email address from your Voi account.

Finally, if you have screenshots of any error messages you may be getting, please share them and I’ll take a closer look to understand what may be the issue.

Macro: discounts_credits_activityscore. Title: Discounts::Credits::ActivityScore. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thank you for reaching out.

The Activity Score is a feature designed to emphasize the importance of responsible parking. It provides feedback on your parking behavior to encourage maintaining a high score through consistent responsible parking.

You'll see the Activity Score feature in your Voi app profile. This score is calculated based on various aspects of your parking behavior after each ride and can improve through good future parking behavior. Keep in mind that for specific issues with individual rides, you'll receive separate email communications.

Please feel free to explore the Activity Score feature within your app!

Best,.

Macro: discounts_credits_activityscoreincident. Title: Discounts::Credits::ActivityScoreIncident. Body: Hi Vojtech, 

Thank you for reaching out.

The Activity Score is a new feature designed to emphasise the importance of responsible parking. It provides feedback on your parking behaviour to encourage maintaining a high score through consistent, responsible parking. This score is calculated based on various aspects of your parking behaviour after each ride and can only be updated through improved future parking behaviour. 

I understand that your score was affected due to a recent unexpected incident. Unfortunately, I'm unable to change your score as this changes automatically through parking interactions. I apologise for this inconvenience, and I have issued 3 credits to your account due to this incident.

Your score should change positively with time as long as you continue parking responsibly. In the meantime, please know your account won't be affected negatively due to your current score.

If you have any other concerns, please let me know.

Macro: discounts_credits_fasttrackexception. Title: Discounts::Credits::FastTrackException. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out – and sorry for the confusion.

Some areas in the city require a parking photo regardless of your Activity Score. This is due to local city regulations, so Fast Track parking isn't available everywhere just yet.

We're working on making this clearer in the app so you'll always know what to expect before you park.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,.

Macro: discounts_credits_nofasttrack. Title: Discounts::Credits::NoFastTrack. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out to us.

At the moment, you don’t have access to Fast Track parking because the eligibility criteria are no longer met.

To regain access, you’ll need to:

Complete at least 12 rides within a month, andMaintain an Activity Score of 90 or higher


Once these conditions are met again, Fast Track access should be restored automatically.

If you have any questions or need help checking your Activity Score, feel free to reach out — we’re happy to help.

Macro: usernoncompliance_blocked_sharingprevention. Title: UserNonCompliance::Blocked::SharingPrevention. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thank you for reaching out. Upon reviewing your account, a temporary suspension was placed due to using the same account with multiple devices within a short period of time. The reason for it's that a Voi account can't be shared between multiple devices. For example, if a user tried to log in on a new device several times within a short period of time, his/her account will be temporarily suspended.

I'd recommend you accessing your account on the previous device as advised in the error message. Otherwise, you'll be able to log in on another device on (RESTRICTION END DATE). Please, keep in mind that if the system recognises new attempts of logging in to your account from multiple devices, the account will be suspended again.

We're sorry if this causes you any inconvenience. These measures are a part of our promise to provide a safe and secure service and prevent any unauthorized use of our riders' accounts. We hope for your understanding..

Macro: hardware_vehicleissue_shutdownduringride_battery. Title: Hardware::VehicleIssue::ShutDownDuringRide::Battery. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out.

If the vehicle unexpectedly slowed down or stopped during your ride, it was probably because it ran out of battery.

You can always see the vehicle's battery level in the app by tapping the vehicle’s icon on the map. Once you’ve unlocked a vehicle, you can also see the battery level on the handlebar screen. If the battery light is green, the vehicle is well charged; yellow light means the battery will last for another – short – ride; red light means the vehicle needs charging.

Another possible reason why the vehicle went slower is that you entered a slow-speed or no-riding zone. Check the in-app map to see if you’re in one of these zones.

Please reach out again if you have more questions.

Macro: ride_grouprides_generalinfo. Title: Ride::GroupRides::GeneralInfo. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for getting in touch with us!

Group rides are a new feature in the Voi app that lets you unlock additional vehicles so you can ride together with your friends and family under just one Voi account.

To start a group ride, you would simply select the ‘Start a group ride’ button in the app and then unlock the other vehicles, as normal.

Remember to stick together during your group ride since you'll need to be nearby to end each of the rides once you’ve finished your journey.

To end the ride, you can select each vehicle one by one to end. The host vehicle, which is the first vehicle that was unlocked, must be ended last.

If you have any other questions on the feature, please let me know!.

Macro: ride_helmet_lockgeneralinfo. Title: Ride::Helmet::LockGeneralInfo. Body: Hi {NAME},

Thanks for your message!

Scooters with helmets attached will be shown in the app with a helmet icon. When you scan to ride, you’ll be informed that the scooter has a helmet available for you at no additional cost!

Once you unlock the scooter, if you would like to use the helmet just select the button ‘Unlock Helmet’. Once you hear the beep, grab the helmet from the lock.

Once you’re done riding, simply insert the lock latch at the back of the helmet into the lock hole on the scooter. You can then end your ride as normal in the app.

Macro: ride_helmet_denmarkregulations. Title: Ride::Helmet::DenmarkRegulations. Body: Hi [NAME],

Following the new regulations in Denmark that came into effect on the 1st of January, we've been proactively informing our users about the requirement to wear a helmet when riding an e-scooter.

As a company, we've always encouraged riders to use a helmet and will continue to do so. We've noticed that positive incentives (such as "Helmet Selfie" in the Voi app) and educating users have the biggest impact when it comes to helmet usage but we also know that there are other ways of making riders behave safely, including education, physical infrastructure and much more.

Wearing a helmet remains the responsibility of a rider but we'll do our best to make this process easier for our users. We're currently working on finding the best solution to make sure our users have access to helmets taking into account the current Covid situation and the risks connected to shared helmets.

Macro: account_drivinglicense_typesoflicenses. Title: Account::DrivingLicense::TypesofLicenses. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thank you for reaching out!

According to current regulations, to ride Voi scooters in the UK, you must have the category Q entitlement on the driving licence. A full or provisional UK licence for categories AM, A or B includes entitlement for category Q. So if you have any of these licences, you can ride e-scooters.

As for overseas driving licences, we accept them as well as long as the licence satisfies one of the following conditions:
It’s a valid full licence from an EU or EEA country (as long as it doesn’t prohibit the holder from driving low-speed mopeds and motorcycles);
It’s a valid full licence from another country that entitles the owner to drive a small vehicle (for example, cars, mopeds or motorcycles) for the first 12 months after entering the UK.
​
I hope this makes things clearer!

•In Italy, parking is only allowed in racks and parking areas dedicated to bicycles, mopeds or e-scooters - you'll see these highlighted in blue or green on the map in the app.

• In any case, common sense is the golden rule to follow. Make sure you don't get in the way of pedestrians and never block:
• Pedestrian or vehicle crossings
• Access points to houses, shops or driveways
• Public transport stops
• Always use the kickstand - this will keep the scooter upright. Think about people who need to pass by in a wheelchair or with the help of a pushchair.

Macro: payments_authorisationhold_explanation. Title: Payments::AuthorisationHold::Explanation. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thank you for reaching out!

Please allow me to clarify that what appears as a pending charge on your bank statement is an authorisation hold and not an actual charge. An authorisation deposit is a way to verify the payment method, but isn't withdrawn from your card/bank account.

When we make an authorisation hold depends on certain circumstances*:

• The first ride following a new payment method
• Sometimes after a payment method has been changed
• The first ride after a failed payment attempt

*Please know that an authorization hold may be triggered multiple times until we have captured a certain amount on the payment method. If this is the case, this should only affect you for a small number of rides.

After you end your ride, you'll only be charged for unlocking the scooter and the actual riding time. To confirm the actual charge taken for the ride, please select ’Receipts’ in your Voi app for an overview of the costs associated with the ride. If the cost of the ride surpasses the authorisation hold amount, then a new charge will be made to cover the remaining cost of the ride and the authorisation hold won't be returned.

Voi releases the authorisation deposit/hold immediately after the ride, but when you’ll be able to see the adjustment to your available balance, depends on your payment method or bank. Some banks release the hold within a few business days, and others might take 1-7 business days. If the hold isn't released within this timeframe, we strongly encourage you to reach out to your bank or payment method of choice.

I appreciate your understanding and I’m glad I could help clear up any billing confusion today!

Regards,.

Macro: payments_authorisationhold_pushback. Title: Payments::AuthorisationHold::Pushback. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thank you for your response.

We want to reiterate that we’re indeed sorry to hear about your experience with our authorisation hold. We take such feedback into consideration whenever we re-evaluate our approach towards our temporary deposit holds.

As mentioned previously, we can only reassure you that the pending charge hasn't been withdrawn from your card/ bank account and that the authorisation hold has already been released by us. It's now up to your bank/payment provider to release the hold from their side.

Since the authorisation hold isn't an actual charge, when the bank/payment provider releases the hold, you may not see it show up as a refund to your account. Instead, it will usually show up as an adjustment to your available balance or as a removal of the pending charge from your account.

We strongly encourage you to review the receipt associated with the ride to confirm the actual charge taken by Voi and to reach out to your bank/payment provider if more than 7 business days have passed, but the hold is still visible.

Let us know if we can assist you with anything else.

Regards,.

Macro: payments_preliminarycharge. Title: Payments::PreliminaryCharge. Body: Hi Vojtech,

What you're seeing is our ‘Preliminary Charge’. Whenever you add a new payment method we need to verify that the card is valid and functional. To do this we try to charge 10SEK/1€ (depending on city). The charge will usually show as ‘pending’ on your card and the transaction will be reverted right after, which means that the money will never be withdrawn from your account. This is an internal security procedure we do with every payment method.

Please let me know if you have any further questions!.

Macro: payments_authorisationhold_bancontactexplanation. Title: Payments::AuthorisationHold::BancontactExplanation. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thank you for reaching out!

Please allow me to clarify that what appears as a pending charge on your bank statement is a temporary hold to verify the payment method and not an actual charge.

If using Bancontact as a payment method, you'll experience a temporary hold of €7.50 on every ride you take.

After you end your ride, you'll only be charged for unlocking the scooter and the actual riding time. To confirm the actual charge taken for the ride, please select ’Receipts’ in your Voi app for an overview of the costs associated with the ride.

Voi releases the hold immediately after the ride, but when you’ll be able to see the adjustment to your available balance, depends on your payment method or bank. Some banks release the hold within a few business days, and others might take 1-7 business days. If the hold isn't released within this timeframe, we strongly encourage you to reach out to your bank or payment method of choice.

Macro: parking_generalinfo_parkingmodes. Title: Parking::GeneralInfo::ParkingModes. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out.

Rules and regulations regarding parking vary across cities and regions.
In some cities, parking is permitted only in racks and areas designated for e-scooter and e-bike parking. If you’re in such a city, these mandatory parking spaces are marked in blue (‘parking zones’) in the app. Before you set off, find a parking zone near your destination using the in-app map.In other cities, parking is allowed throughout most of the operational area, except in the so-called no-parking and no-riding zones, which are marked on the in-app map. Here, you need to park the vehicle either parallel and close to a wall, in a rack or within a designated parking area.In still other cities, there’s a combination of regulations that applies. This usually means that the city centre has mandatory parking spaces (according to number 1 in this list), while parking outside the city centre is permitted according to number 2.


Check the app for more detailed information about the specific rules and regulations regarding parking that apply in your area.

Macro: discounts_voialty_general. Title: Discounts::Voialty::General. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out.

Voialty is the name of our loyalty programme that lets you earn points simply by using our service. The number of points collected determines your level. Depending on your level, you get a certain discount on your rides.

When you go for a ride, you earn 10 points. You then have 30 days to earn enough points to reach the next level. If you fail to maintain or upgrade your level within those 30 days, you’ll be downgraded to the previous level and your points will reset.

Once upgraded, to maintain your level, you need to earn at least the same amount of points again.

To see your current level, tap the Voialty badge in the right upper corner of the home screen in the app, or go to your profile and tap the Voialty badge there. You’ll then be able to see:

• your current level
• the amount of points you need to maintain your current level / upgrade to the next
• the amount of days left to earn those points.

Any discount received from Voialty will be reflected on your receipt.

If we pause operations in your city and it affects your Voialty progress, reach out to us, and we’ll make sure that you get a discount corresponding to your Voialty level 😊

Scoot safely and enjoy the holiday season!.

Macro: feedback_operations_sundbyberg. Title: Feedback::Operations::Sundbyberg. Body: Hi Vojtech,

You recently shared feedback after trying to use our e-bike service in Sundbyberg – thank you for reaching out!

We’d like to clarify that Voi e-bikes are not yet allowed in Sundbyberg, as we don’t currently have a permit from the municipality. That’s why the e-bike automatically slows down and parking in the area isn’t possible. We’re in ongoing dialogue with the city and hope they’ll welcome e-bikes soon.

In the meantime, you can still use our e-scooters in Sundbyberg as usual. Simply filter by vehicle type in the app to see where e-scooters and e-bikes are available.

Do you live or work in Sundbyberg? Then you can help speed things up! Feel free to contact the city’s Vice Mayor for Traffic, Martin Solberg (Green Party), at martin.solberg@sundbyberg.se, and share why you think e-bikes should be allowed in Sundbyberg too.

Thanks for being part of the Voi movement!

Set subject
E-bikes in Sundbyberg? Your voice can make a difference.

Macro: operations_vehicles_wrongparkdisabilities. Title: Operations::Vehicles::WrongPark(Disabilities). Body: Hello Vojtech!

We of course understand your concerns, and I assure you that we're working on ways to be more inclusive and mindful of people with disabilities. We work in direct contact with city authorities to make sure we integrate our scooters into cities in an appropriate and smooth way.

These photos may be reviewed internally, and if a vehicle is found to be improperly parked, it's flagged for relocation. Depending on the user's parking history, they may receive an educational email, a warning, or a fine.

Macro: parking_endride_noparkingzone. Title: Parking::EndRide::NoParkingZone. Body: Hello Vojtech,

Scooters have to be parked or reserved within the operational zone that shows in white on the map. These are the areas defined and designated in the Voi App in which the Scooters may be operated and made available. The limits of the area where Voi is operating are represented in the App as a red geofence.

Remember that if you try to park in “No parking zones” you’ll get a message asking you to bring the scooter back. Ending the ride in this red zone may lead to a penalty of 25 GBP/Euro or even higher.

I hope this helps to answer your concern. Have a nice day!.

Macro: parking_parkingassistant_fine_belgium. Title: Parking::ParkingAssistant::Fine::Belgium. Body: Hi Vojtech,

You’re receiving this email because your parking with scooter {INSERT ID} on {INSERT DATE} resulted in a fine of {INSERT AMOUNT}€ from {INSERT CITY NAME} for obstructing the pathway.

We want our scooters to be safe for everyone. This includes both riders and pedestrians, and especially, those with disabilities or visually impaired. Wrongly parked scooters can be dangerous for these groups of people when they’re trying to pass by.

In Belgium, you should always park your scooter with both wheels parallel and completely against a wall or in a bike rack, and be sure to leave at least 1.5 meters of space on the pavement and 2.5 meters from tactile pavement for the blind. This will make sure that all pedestrians, especially those in a wheelchair or with a stroller, are able to safely pass. You can read more about how to park an e-scooter here https://www.voi.com/fr/stationnement/.

As this is the first time that your parking has gone against local regulations, we'll cover the cost of the fine in this instance. Any future fines due to parking the scooter incorrectly may be charged to your payment method on file.

We want to make sure that our scooters are an integral part of the cities and seeing them parked correctly represents a sustainable, innovative, safe, and fun solution for everyone involved. We appreciate your understanding in helping to keep our cities safe.

Best,.

Each submitted photo goes through a careful review process to ensure it aligns with local requirements. We utilize machine learning to assist in quickly identifying aspects like parking quality and more. You can learn more about Parking Assistant and what it is on our FAQs.

You received this email and fee due to not parking in line with the local parking regulations on several occasions.  You can view how many rides you have where your parking did not meet the local requirements in the app under ‘Profile’ and then ‘Activity Score’.

In your city, the vehicle must be parked either:

In a painted parking bayIn a scooter parking rack (bike racks are not allowed for parking e-scooters!)Neat - standing upright and not causing clutterNot blocking the path or any entrances for pedestrians


In some areas in your city, it may be allowed to also park the vehicle parallel and close to the wall. You can view the areas of the city in which this is allowed on the map in the app.

You can check our website and select your city or visit the ‘Parking quick guide’ under the Help section in the app in order to find the specific parking requirements that need to be followed.

Please let us know if you have any questions, we are here to help!
 
Best regards,.

Macro: payments_authorisationhold_cancellationif_ride_cost_0. Title: Payments::AuthorisationHold::Cancellation(if_ride_cost_0). Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thank you for reaching out!

Please allow me to clarify that what appears as a pending charge on your bank statement is an authorisation deposit/hold and not an actual charge. An authorisation deposit is a way to verify the payment method, but isn't withdrawn from your card/ bank account.

When we make an authorisation hold depends on which payment method you’ve chosen to use:

• The first ride following a new payment method
• Sometimes after a payment method has been changed
• The first ride after a failed payment attempt

If the price of the ride was 0 or you paid for the ride with Voi credits, the authorisation hold will be used for your next ride or automatically voided within 10 days.

The authorisation is usually released automatically, but since you contacted us, I’ve canceled it manually. Depending on your bank or payment method, the hold should be released within 7 business days. If the hold isn't released within this timeframe, we strongly encourage you to reach out to your bank or payment method of choice. To confirm the actual charge taken for each ride, please select ’Receipts’ in your Voi app for an overview of the costs associated with the ride.

I appreciate your understanding and I’m glad I could help clear up any billing confusion today!

Regards,.

Macro: ride_howtoridepark. Title: Ride::HowtoRide/Park. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Welcome to Voi – we’re excited to have you onboard!

By signing up, you’ve taken your first step towards contributing to making your city a greener, healthier place – with less pollution, less noise and less stress. Here are some quick tips on how to get started.

FIRE UP THE APP TO FIND A SCOOTER
Scan the QR code on the middle of the handlebar to unlock the vehicle.

CHECK THE MAP AND PLAN YOUR ROUTE
Be sure to familiarise yourself with the different Voi zones before you set off.

GET THAT SCOOTER ROLLING
Push off with a foot a few times to get the scooter rolling before using the throttle.

PARK CONSIDERATELY
Help keep the pavements an accessible space for all by parking properly.

Remember that road safety begins with you. Be sure to know the local rules of the road before you set off. Stick to the bike lanes or close to the side curb, and stay off pavements as well as roads with speeds over 50 km/h (50 mph). Always wear a helmet to protect your head, and never ride under the influence of mind-altering substances (such as alcohol).

Enjoy!

If the ride is ended automatically after 1.5 hours, depending on where the vehicle is located you might receive reminders on how to park correctly.

Macro: subscription_voipass_replaced. Title: Subscription::VoiPass::Replaced. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thank you for reaching out.

Our subscription offering is influenced by several factors such as operational costs, including fleet maintenance, along with city-imposed fees related to our services in certain cities.

We recently updated our subscription models to offer more flexible and tailored options for our users. Our new plans include:

• Discounted Minute Rate Pass - a subscription that gives you unlimited unlocks and a lower per-minute rate for a fixed monthly fee. It renews automatically every 30 days, but you can cancel anytime.
• Fixed Ride Price Pass - a subscription that lets you pay a fixed monthly fee for unlimited unlocks and a discounted fixed ride cost for rides up to 20 minutes. If your ride is longer than 20 minutes, the extra time will be charged at the regular per-minute rate.

We understand that changes can cause inconvenience. However, we aim to make sure we provide the best service possible by balancing quality, safety, and affordability.

Also, we offer various discounts and have a referral program that rewards you when you invite friends to try Voi. Pricing and availability may vary based on your location, so we recommend checking the Voi app for the most accurate information.

We hope this clarifies your concern.

Best,.

Macro: subscription_voipass_stackeddiscountsuk. Title: Subscription::VoiPass::StackedDiscountsUK. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Our engineers have since then found the issue and fixed it in our system. This means that the price you are requested to pay now for this subscription is the intended price, considering the discount already offered.

I apologize for the confusion but I want to clarify that this is the correct price. I understand that you were paying less previously for this same product, so I advise you to check our other offers at lower prices that may still fit your budget.

If we can help you with anything else, please let us know.

Best regards,.

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_badridingbehaviouruk. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::BadRidingBehaviourUK. Body: Hello (Name),

Thank you for your message and for raising your concerns with us. We definitely agree that safety should be the first priority for all scooter operators. Find below the actions that we take right now to ensure our scooters are safe for everyone, including riders, pedestrians, and other vehicles.

Before being able to unlock a scooter, all users need to show proof of a valid driving licence. This helps us to ensure that those riding are aware of traffic regulations that must be followed. Users will also need to go through a training module before their first ride to familiarise themselves with how to properly ride an e-scooter.

We encourage riders to always use a helmet when operating a Voi. Wearing a helmet is not a legal requirement, but our team will continue to raise awareness on the importance of protecting yourself while riding an e-scooter. For example, right now we encourage users to take a selfie with a helmet when they try to unlock a scooter. If the AI in the app confirms that the person on the photo is wearing a helmet, the user receives points on their account.

Also, we provide explicit guidelines about using Voi scooters on our website​. Beyond this, we have our own RideSafe Academy​which educates users about riding safely and brings awareness to this important topic (riders are incentivized to complete the classes and get a reward).

If we receive a complaint regarding bad riding behaviour we immediately take appropriate action, such as issuing a warning, strike and/or blocking the account in question. In all UK cities, we also process and analyze parking photos that users take at the end of their rides to make sure we do not have any scooters on the streets parked in a way that could be dangerous for others. Based on the outcome, the scooter might be moved or picked up while the user might receive an educational email, warning

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_generalreportnotforuk. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::GeneralReport(NotforUK). Body: Dear Vojtech,

Thank you for reaching out and sharing your concerns with us. Ensuring safety is our utmost priority and we appreciate your help in this matter.

Whenever we receive reports of behaviour that violates our User Agreement, we conduct thorough investigations in an effort to take appropriate actions against the user's account. To help us conduct our investigations, we ask that whenever reporting this type of behaviour to also provide us with:
The 4 digit ID code of the scooter located at the back of the scooter (if identifiable from where you witnessed the incident)Any image or video evidence of the observed behaviour to support the report


This information significantly helps us in accurately identifying the responsible user.

We greatly appreciate you taking the time to report this improper use of scooters. Your added layer of support helps us to achieve our goals to provide a safe and eco-friendly mode of transportation.

Best,.

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_mop_1stwarning. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::MOP::1stWarning. Body: Hi Vojtech,

We hope you’re enjoying our scooters!

Unfortunately, we’re reaching out to let you know that we’ve received a report which suggests that you’ve been riding against our User Agreement, in particular - (PASTE THE REASON).

We want to make sure that our scooters are operated safely for both riders and pedestrians in accordance with local traffic regulations. For this reason, we’ve agreed with local municipalities and police enforcement that any of the following behaviours may lead to the suspension of a Voi account.
Twin ridingUnderage ridingRiding under the influence of alcohol or other substancesRiding on the pavementRiding outside the Voi operational zoneRiding dangerously on the roadParking the scooter incorrectly

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_pavementriding_fine. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::PavementRiding::Fine. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out – I understand it can be frustrating to see a charge like this. I’ll explain what happened.

Our system flagged repeated pavement riding on your recent rides. After earlier reminders, this led to a penalty fee being applied to your account, in line with our user agreement and privacy policy.

We use ride data from the Voi vehicle to detect this type of behaviour. This helps us keep rides safe and apply our rules consistently. We can’t share the exact detection details, as that could make it easier to bypass the system.

Pavement riding isn’t allowed because it puts people around you at risk. To ride safely, use cycle lanes where available, or the road if not.

As a one-time gesture, we’ve refunded this fee. It may take a few business days for the amount to appear, depending on your bank.

If you have any other questions, feel free to ask.

Best regards,.

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_pavementriding_warning. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::PavementRiding::Warning. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out – I’m happy to clarify this for you.

We understand that receiving a warning like this can feel unexpected. I’ll explain how it works and what it means for you.

Our system flags possible pavement riding based on data from the Voi vehicle and your ride. We use this data to help keep rides safe and to apply our rules fairly, as set out in our user agreement and privacy policy. We don’t share the exact details of how detection works, as that could make it easier to misuse the system.

What I can confirm is:
- We only use the data that’s needed to run the service safely and enforce our terms.
- Riding on the pavement can put people around you at risk, especially pedestrians.
- This warning is a reminder to help prevent unsafe situations going forward.

To ride safely, always use cycle lanes where available, or the road if not.

If you believe this warning was sent by mistake, let us know – we’ll be happy to take a closer look at your case.

If you have any other questions, feel free to ask.

Best regards,.

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_ridersbelow16norway. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::RidersBelow16-Norway. Body: Hello Vojtech,

Our terms and conditions explicitly state that individuals under 16 in Oslo aren’t allowed to use the service. When a user tries to scan a scooter for the first time, it's mandatory for them to provide a copy of their ID along with a selfie in order for us to verify their information before they're able to unlock any scooter.

Reported cases of underaged riders will be taken seriously and our team will continue to work to identify further measures to prevent this and make it more difficult for those who are underage to break the rules.

We appreciate the time you took to reach out to us and if you have any further thoughts or suggestions, please let us know!

Best,.

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_ridersbelow18. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::RidersBelow18. Body: Hello Vojtech,

Thank you for your message. We appreciate you reporting this to us.

We definitely agree with you that underage riding is unacceptable, and for that reason, it’s one of our top priorities to implement a permanent solution that would prevent underage individuals from riding Voi scooters.

We’d like to assure you that we’re doing everything in our capacity to guarantee that our scooters are operated according to local laws and traffic rules. Our terms and conditions explicitly state that individuals under 18 aren’t allowed to use the service. In some locations, we managed to implement even stricter measures, such as requiring users to upload a driving licence to ride Voi scooters.

We take every report of underage riding very seriously and investigate each case to take further action. Our team will continue working on identifying further measures to prevent this and make it more difficult for underage individuals to break the rules.

Once again, thank you for your feedback. With the help of citizens like you, we’re building an infrastructure for e-scooters that would represent a safe and reliable mode of transportation for riders and those around.

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_tandemriding_fine. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::TandemRiding::Fine. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for getting in touch – I’m happy to clarify this.

We understand that being charged a fee like this can feel frustrating. The charge was applied after our system detected repeated rides where a Voi vehicle may have been used by more than one rider, despite earlier reminders.

Using a Voi vehicle with a passenger isn’t allowed under our user agreement, which is why a fee was applied in this case.

Our system uses signals from the vehicle to identify patterns that may indicate tandem riding. We don’t share the exact details, but we only use the data needed to operate the service safely and enforce our terms.

We’ve refunded the fee as a one-time exception. Depending on your bank, it may take a few business days before it appears on your account.

To avoid this in the future, please make sure each rider uses their own Voi vehicle. When travelling together, you can:
- unlock another Voi vehicle using Group Ride (where available)
- share your referral code so your friend can ride on their own account.

Further violations may lead to additional fees or account suspension.

Any other questions, just let me know – I’m here to help.

Best regards,.

Macro: usernoncompliance_asb_tandemriding_warning. Title: UserNonCompliance::ASB::TandemRiding::Warning. Body: Hi Vojtech,

Thanks for reaching out – I’m happy to explain.

We understand that getting a warning like this can feel unexpected. The message you received is triggered when our system detects that a Voi vehicle may have been used by more than one rider.

Each Voi vehicle is for one rider only. Riding with a passenger isn’t allowed and increases the risk of accidents – for you, your passenger, and people around you – which is why it goes against our user agreement.

Our system uses signals from the vehicle to identify patterns that may indicate tandem riding. We don’t share the exact details of how this works, but we only use the data that’s necessary to operate the service safely and enforce our terms.

The warning is a reminder rather than a penalty. It’s there to help prevent unsafe situations going forward.

If you’re riding with someone, there are a couple of easy ways to do that safely:
- Unlock another Voi vehicle for them using Group Ride (where available).
- Share your referral code so they can start riding on their own account.

Think this warning was sent by mistake? Let us know, and we’ll have another look.

Have any other questions? I’m here to help.
Best regards,.

Macro: usernoncompliance_cityfines_manualfiningbrusselsonlyforagentstrainedontask. Title: UserNonCompliance::CityFines::ManualFiningBrussels(OnlyForAgentsTrainedOnTask). Body: À plusieurs reprises, nous avons constaté des cas de stationnement incorrects, ce qui nous a entraîné des frais pour déplacer ou repositionner les scooters.

Votre photo la plus récente indiquait un stationnement non conforme, ce qui nous a obligés à repositionner le véhicule pour qu'il soit conforme à nos exigences et celles de la ville. En conséquence de cette violation des termes et conditions de notre accord utilisateur​​, nous avons subides coûts liés au repositionnement, et vous êtes responsable de ces dépenses.

Nous vous facturerons donc 5 €. Si vous ne parvenez pas à soumettre à nouveau une photo de stationnement de qualité suffisante, vous risquez une nouvelle facturation.

Une question de sécurité
Les photos de stationnement sont une partie importante de notre travail pour veiller à ce que les véhicules ne polluent pas nos rues, voire pire - ne représentent pas un danger pour les piétons.

Et maintenant?
Pour éviter de nouveaux frais, veuillez respecter l'accord utilisateur à l'avenir :
Assurez-vous que l'intégralité du véhicule est visible sur la photo, ainsi que son environnement immédiat.
Utilisez le flash s'il fait sombre.
Vérifiez la qualité de votre cliché avant de le soumettre - nous avons besoin de photos nettes et sans flou, sans reflets.
Renseignez-vous sur nos règles de stationnement et consultez les réponses aux questions fréquentes sur le même sujet. Si quelque chose n'est pas clair, ou si vous pensez que nous avons fait une évaluation incorrecte, contactez notre équipe de support.

Cordialement,
l'équipe Voi.

Macro: usernoncompliance_stolenemail_explanation. Title: UserNonCompliance::StolenEmail::Explanation. Body: Hi Vojtech,

When you register a Voi account, you need to enter your mobile number and verify the same before you add an email address to the account. In other words, you’re never asked to verify your email address.

Anyways, the other account is now suspended.

If you didn’t notice any inexplicable charges on your payment method, it’s likely your email address was added to this other account simply by mistake.

If you do notice inexplicable charges, immediately report this to your bank or payment method provider. They’ll be able to prevent further unauthorised transactions and dispute charges for your funds to be returned to you.

Reach out again if you have more questions.

Macro: usernoncompliance_voiemployees_reminder. Title: UserNonCompliance::VoiEmployees::Reminder. Body: Hi!

We hope that you are enjoying riding Voi for free as a part of your employment perks 😊 However, it seems that during your last ride, you didn’t follow the Safety Policy​​ that you’ve previously signed with Voi. What we mean by "not following the policy" is that your ride with the scooter (SCOOTER ID) was going on for more than 2 hours / the scooter (SCOOTER ID) was left in a No-Parking Zone (SELECT THE APPROPRIATE OPTION).

We should always remember that being a Voi employee means being an ambassador of the brand. Leaving scooters in a No Parking Zone or not ending the ride in the app means that those scooters will be left there alone and unavailable for other riders. Let’s all be good role models for our users by following the rules and riding safely!.
